WITH rep_customer_counts AS (
  SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(c.CustomerId) as customer_count
  FROM Employee e
  INNER JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId
  GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City
),
city_averages AS (
  SELECT City, AVG(customer_count) as avg_count
  FROM rep_customer_counts
  GROUP BY City
),
filtered_reps AS (
  SELECT rcc.EmployeeId, rcc.City, rcc.customer_count, ca.avg_count
  FROM rep_customer_counts rcc
  JOIN city_averages ca ON rcc.City = ca.City
  WHERE rcc.customer_count > ca.avg_count
)
SELECT 
  fr.City,
  SUM(fr.customer_count) as total_customers,
  AVG(fr.customer_count - fr.avg_count) as avg_above_average,
  AVG(fr.customer_count / (SELECT SUM(customer_count) FROM filtered_reps)) as avg_share
FROM filtered_reps fr
GROUP BY fr.City
ORDER BY fr.City
